key.name: llm-api-key
key.description: API key for the LLM provider

key.name: llm-base-url
key.description: Base URL for the LLM API endpoint

key.name: llm-model
key.description: The model name to use for translation

key.name: llm-system-prompt
key.default: 'You are a professional translator. Translate the given text accurately and naturally. Provide only the translation without any extra explanation unless asked.'
key.description: The system/base role prompt sent to the LLM

key.name: llm-user-prompt
key.default: 'Translate the following text. If it is in {source_lang}, translate to {target_lang}. If it is in {target_lang}, translate to {source_lang}. Text:\n\n{text}'
key.description: The user prompt template. Use {text} for input, {source_lang} for source language, and {target_lang} for target language.

key.name: translate-with-notification
key.description: Key to translate current selection and show the result in a Notification

key.name: translate-from-selection
key.description: Key to toggle the translate menu with selected text
